text: Ok. so now one more time. i have the fire hydrant selected. It says tile asphalt. ? i have not placed the prop either. [Image #6] also, this gutter that has paint obj notes and chat. remove that. all of it is useless trash. i only use the one paint tab
resolution: Two fixes. (1) 'TILE Asphalt' while holding the Fire Hydrant: shownFocus fell back to the current tile BRUSH whenever nothing placed was selected, so the properties panel ignored the held item. Added armedFocus — when an unplaced PROP is held (armed id 'prop.<kind>'), it builds the same one-object preview placeFocus uses, dressed with the staged part textures (armedDraft) so it previews exactly what will drop; shownFocus/focusWorld now prefer it over the tile default. So holding the hydrant shows the hydrant's properties, not asphalt. (Non-prop held build pieces still fall through to the default — noted as a follow-up.) (2) Removed the PAINT/OBJ/NOTE/CHAT nav rail entirely — the user only uses PAINT, so RightPanel is now just the FacePainter full-width (reclaims the 46px the rail ate). The TabId type + the cart's tab state are kept because useMapSession/usePlacements persist + auto-switch a ; ObjectsTab/NotesTab/ChatTab are simply no longer rendered (files left in place, not deleted). Built clean. Committed 533cb82c9. Needs rjit dev eyes (editor self-shot OOMs). Heads-up: removing the OBJ tab also removes the per-kind texture inspector that lived there; if that authoring is still wanted it can resurface in the paint panel.
